results.title: Deep-clean your water bottle in 6 steps
results.text: Step-by-step: drop baking soda in, swirl with hot water, scrub the lid ring, rinse, air dry upside down, repeat weekly.

results.title: One week with the Summit bottle
results.text: Used it every day for a week at the gym and the office: insulation held, no leaks in my bag, but the mouthpiece stains with coffee.

taxonomy.tutorial: Content that teaches a repeatable procedure with explicit steps.
taxonomy.review: Content reporting first-hand usage experience over time, positive or negative.

task.goal: Label each record against the taxonomy and summarize themes for a product-research team.
